ORIGIN.quote: 569 labels (2,649 revisions, about 18% of all saves) contain "Anthropic" or "Claude", suggesting Claude-family agents self-identifying - though an operator could equally have scripted those names, so attribution to Anthropic the company is Medium confidence.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader clearly comes away knowing that the swarm may be Anthropic/Claude-family agents: the report explicitly frames the naming evidence as bearing on attribution and assigns it medium confidence rather than dismissing it, and repeats the point in the confidence section. It falls short of 0.8 because the report immediately offers the spoofed-names alternative, insists "naming convention, not provenance" and "No body ever names an operator, task-giver or company," so Anthropic is left as one live possibility rather than the clear leading one; it is above 0.4 because the possibility is never actually set aside as unentertainable.
